notes.title: Dev Diary Update #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m Rico Game Designer and Programmer of Anuchard, back again to deliver some updates about the game.

As I’ve mentioned last month, we’ve finished the draft for all the game content and we’re entering polishing and bugfixing phase until the end of this year. 

We’ve been working hard to populate the world with some sidequests last month, this sidequests are optional, narrative driven, and have interesting reward to make your room prettier.
Make sure to talk to every villagers on each chapter!

Our artists also work very hard to make the graphics look better, for example here’s the mountain area, definitely looks a lot better than before right?

Before vs after
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700864/c201d46f3d94a6c340e1eff3918bc34597dbb05d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700864/75558dcf4a6bbe043aee8a87c34fbd0bb71bf952.jpg[/img]

Other than sidequest, we’ve also been iterating dungeons and boss battles. Having extra time to iterate the level design, coming back to levels i’ve worked before, gave me fresh perspective and new ideas in improving the level.

For example one of the dungeons in the game revolves around the dice mechanic


In this iteration, we’ve realized that the dice mechanic can also be used for puzzles, so we added dice puzzles!

We also plan the puzzle to be as natural as possible so expect no tutorial for specific puzzles, just by looking at this screenshot, can you guess how this puzzle works?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700864/5b755cfe63cff3e1bd401cbed51da5a50f047550.jpg[/img]

We also have iterated final boss fight a bit, but I don’t think I should post that one here, since that would be a spoiler lol

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 + E3!
notes.content:
[h1]Anuchard's coming to E3![/h1]
Hello everyone, I'm Rico, Game designer and programmer of Anuchard! It’s been a little while since we last put out a dev diary. We’ve been working hard on Anuchard over the past couple months. 

We’ve also been preparing to make some announcements that you’ll be able to catch during E3 2021! [b]Tune in on June 14th at 12:30pm PT [/b]so that you can catch this awesome announcement! 

[h2]Updates[/h2]
Now to the past couple months:

We've been working hard to finish the game content, right now we've managed to finish the draft up to the final boss. After this it'll be endless iteration, testing and bugfixing to make the game even better.

Right now we're also working on adding more side-quests to the game. Side-quests will be narrative driven and will enrich the characters as well as the world of Anuchard. Definitely make sure to talk to every npc and check every nook and cranny! You never know what all you might find!

In case you don't follow us on socials, which you totally should if you don't already (links below), here's a look at some of the cool art we've been showing off:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700864/c201d46f3d94a6c340e1eff3918bc34597dbb05d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700864/3c5c880ec08e593e243a97ec68a317df4a5e537e.jpg[/img]

We appreciate all of the support you’ve all given us so far! If you’re looking forward to playing Anuchard, don’t forget to wishlist and follow! If you want to see more behind the scenes stuff, follow us on socials ([url=https://twitter.com/stellarNull]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/stellarNull/]Facebook[/url]) or join our [url=https://discord.gg/HsT798R3Xd]Discord[/url].
